A-deer-drive-0085.name: By Steffens Creek
A-deer-drive-0085.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
A-deer-drive-0085.parkWhat: pull off on Coyote Valley Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-3-003 unit 205 (official), right here. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Interior Douglas fir (IDFxh2): low winter and fall range.
Private fields 110 m W: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).

flags.t: Private land 110 m W: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: 4 point bucks: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)
4 point bucks: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)
LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from Heffley Creek, about 101 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5 (Yellowhead Hwy), Old Hwy 5, 7th St, Fortune Dr.
Park: 50.24975, -120.80272, pull off on Coyote Valley Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 100 m W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 15 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2021 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-19, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-03, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-03.
